title: Blue Hour and Radiators
author: Cyrus Fairweather
blurb: Beatrix Lockridge, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, has spent three years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it before the demolition date arrives.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
